purpose: Teach: デュアル/ダイアログ/コンパイル/アンカー/グリッド/シールド/レビューア/コストパフォーマンス
target_vocab: コストパフォーマンス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、デュアル事業展開を考えられた
lines.en: Father — when he was starting out, he considered a dual-track business model.
lines.style: Gentle, measured opening. Soft nostalgia in the voice. Pause before 'Father' as if calling across time. Unhurried pace, reflective.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはダイアログを大切にされる経営者だった
lines.en: Yes. My father was a leader who truly valued dialogue.
lines.style: Steady, respectful confirmation. Slight warmth on 'dialogue.' Not stiff — speaking of someone real. Clear eye-level delivery, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、コンパイル言語の進化を見守られた
lines.en: Father — in those early years, he watched the evolution of programming languages unfold.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Slight breathiness on 'watched.' Pace slows on 'evolution' — like he's seeing it again. Trailing quiet at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは式典でアンカーを御自らされた事もある
lines.en: Yes. My father even took the lead as anchor at company ceremonies himself.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Slight emphasis on 'himself' — pride without boasting. Warm but composed. Steady, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、工場の生産ラインのグリッド配置を御自ら設計された
lines.en: Father — when he was young, he personally designed the grid layout for the factory floor.
lines.style: Tender admiration underlying the words. Soft focus on 'personally designed' — a man of detail. Slow, deliberate pace. Trailing off gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは安全シールド設備の導入に積極的だった
lines.en: Yes. My father was genuinely committed to installing safety equipment.
lines.style: Firm conviction underneath. Gentle emphasis on 'genuinely' — this matters to say. Not defensive, but steady. Clear, honest delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、外部レビューア、つまり評価者の意見を尊重された
lines.en: Father — he truly respected the input of outside evaluators and critics.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. Slight pause before 'outside evaluators' — the humility in him. Slow, unhurried. Voice softens at the end, almost marveling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品のコストパフォーマンスに拘られた
lines.en: Yes. My father had high standards when it came to value for money.
lines.style: Warm, summative finality. Slight weight on 'value' — this was his measure. Breath of closure in the voice. Not rushed, but complete. A gentle landing.
